home.title: Wishlists
home.lead: Make a list and share the link. Buyers sort it out here, and you don’t get to see it.
home.openedIntro: When someone sends you the link to a list, you find it here again. Removing a list only takes it off this page; the link keeps working.
home.openedEmpty: No lists yet. Open the link someone sent you.

notice.wish_linked: {actor} added “{title}” to a list of their own. You now share that wish.
notice.wish_unlinked: {actor} unlinked you from “{title}”. You now have a copy of your own.
notice.joint_link_used: {actor} used your link. “{title}” now belongs to {actor} too. | {actor} used your link. “{title}” and {n} other wish now belong to {actor} too. | {actor} used your link. “{title}” and {n} other wishes now belong to {actor} too.

list.empty: There is nothing on this list yet.
list.deleted: {names} deleted this list. What was already bought stays here. | {names} deleted this list. What was already bought stays here.
list.deleteBody: The list disappears, with every wish on it. You can’t undo this.
list.inviteText: This link works once. Whoever opens it becomes a co-owner of this list and of every wish on it.
list.leaveBody: You will no longer own this list, nor the wishes on it that aren’t on another list of yours. The list stays with {names}.

wish.yours: You got this yourself | You got {n} yourself
wish.anonHint: Log in to tick what you are getting.
wish.removedIntro: {names} took this off the list after someone bought it. It stays here so you can sort it out. | {names} took this off the list after someone bought it. It stays here so you can sort it out.
wish.removeBody: The wish leaves this list. It stays on the other lists that show it.
wish.deleteBody: The wish disappears from your list. You can’t undo this.

joint.linkText: This link works once. Whoever opens it becomes a co-owner of the chosen wishes and from then on no longer sees who buys them.

listEdit.label: Edit the list
listEdit.selected: Choose wishes to delete or share | {n} wish chosen | {n} wishes chosen
listEdit.deleteTitle: Delete this wish? | Delete these {n} wishes?
listEdit.deleteBody: They disappear from your list. You can’t undo this.
listEdit.deleteBodyElsewhere: Wishes that are also on another list only leave this one.
listEdit.moveHelp: Use the up and down arrow keys to move the wish.
listEdit.orderFailed: The new order wasn’t saved. The list shows the last saved order.

unlink.title: Unlink {name} from “{title}”?
unlink.body: {name} gets a copy of their own, without purchases. Nothing about your wish changes.

add.linkedHint: You then share one wish, bought once. From then on you no longer see who buys it.
add.copyHint: A wish of your own, separate from this one. Nobody is told.
add.removed: This wish is no longer on the list.

invite.title: A link that works once
invite.wishes: {from} shares a wish with you | {from} shares {n} wishes with you
invite.wishesLead: Choose which of your lists it goes on. You become a co-owner of it and from then on no longer see who buys it. | Choose which of your lists they go on. You become a co-owner of them and from then on no longer see who buys them.
invite.listLead: You become a co-owner of this list and of every wish on it. From then on you no longer see who buys what there.
invite.closed: This link no longer works. Ask {from} for a new one.
invite.own: This is your own link. Send it to the person you want to share with.
invite.alreadyOwner: You are already a co-owner of this list.

purchase.title: Who is buying this?
purchase.anonymousHint: The other buyers see “Someone else” instead of your name. The owners never see who gives what anyway.

tick.warning: You might find out that someone already got this. Continue?
tick.removed: This is no longer on the list. You can only lower or remove your own amount.
tick.goneFromList: “{title}” no longer exists and has gone from the list.

auth.loginLead: Log in to see who is buying what.
auth.registerLead: An account lets you make your own lists and see who is buying what on other people’s lists.
auth.displayNameHint: This is how others see you.
auth.forgotLead: Enter your email address. You’ll get an email with a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If {email} has an account, the email is on its way. Check your spam too.

settings.title: Settings
settings.profileIntro: The name others see on your lists and purchases.
settings.passwordIntro: Choose a new password. You stay logged in.
settings.googleIntro: Log in with your Google account instead of your password.
settings.googleOn: You can log in with Google.
settings.googleLinked: Google is linked. You can log in with it from now on.
settings.passwordSetIntro: You log in with Google. Want to log in with a password too? You’ll get an email with a link to choose one.
settings.passwordMailSent: The email is on its way to {email}.

error.notFoundBody: The address is wrong, or the list is gone.
error.otherBody: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, try again later.

errors.validation: Check the fields below and try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email address or password is wrong.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email address already exists. Log in, or use another address.
errors.email_same: This is already your email address.
errors.registration_closed: No more accounts can be added. Ask whoever runs the site.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.
errors.not_found: That no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.list_limit: You have the most lists you can have. Delete one you no longer need first.
errors.list_limit_ever: You have made as many lists as one account may. Ask whoever runs the site.
errors.wish_limit: This list is full. Delete a wish first.
errors.wish_limit_ever: This list has had too many wishes. Make a new list.
errors.note_limit: This wish has too many notes. Delete one of your own notes first.
errors.too_large: That is too large. Choose a smaller image or shorten your text.
errors.invalid_image: That file isn’t a JPEG, PNG or WebP. Choose another image.
errors.bad_origin: This request came from another site and was refused.
errors.list_shared: Someone else owns this list too. Leave it instead; the last owner can delete it.
errors.last_owner: You are the last owner of this list. Delete it instead of leaving it.
errors.invite_closed: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one.
errors.google_failed: Logging in with Google didn’t work. Try again.
errors.google_unverified: Google hasn’t confirmed this email address. Confirm it at Google first.
errors.google_email_taken: An account with this email address already exists. Log in below with your password, then link Google under Settings.
errors.google_taken: That Google account already belongs to another account here.
errors.password_needed: Set a password first, or you won’t be able to log in any more.
errors.firebase_missing: Logging in isn’t set up yet. Ask whoever runs the site.
errors.reauth_needed: Log out and in again, then try once more.

fields.invalid_email: That isn’t a valid email address.
fields.password_short: Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
fields.invalid_url: Start the link with http:// or https://.
fields.invalid_amount: Choose a whole number of 1 or more.
